result.instructions: Tools for CaptiFi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many guests connected to our venue WiFi last week, and how many agreed to marketing?"; "List guest sign-ups from yesterday who may receive marketing."; "Which of our venues are on the account, and what plan are we on?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CaptiFi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run captifi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run captifi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run captifi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. captifi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: captifi_get_account
tools.title: Get the connected account
tools.description: Confirm which CaptiFi account the API key belongs to: business name, plan and venue count. Good first call to test the connection. CaptiFi API: GET /me.

tools.name: captifi_list_venues
tools.title: List venues
tools.description: List the venues on the account, alphabetically, with id, name, city, country and created_at. Use an id as venue_id in the guest and stats tools. CaptiFi API: GET /venues.

tools.name: captifi_list_guests
tools.title: List guest sign-ups
tools.description: List guests who arrived on the venue WiFi, newest first. Returns personal data (name, email, phone) and marketing_consent. Only arrivals appear, not contacts you imported yourself. Use from/to to limit the period. CaptiFi API: GET /guests.

venue_id.description: Limit to one venue id (from captifi_list_venues). Default: every venue on the account.

marketing_consent.description: true = only guests who may get marketing now; false = only guests who may not. Omit for all.

tools.name: captifi_get_stats
tools.title: Get visit and opt-in totals
tools.description: Get totals for a period: visits (every arrival), unique_guests (distinct people) and marketing_opt_ins. Defaults to the last 30 days across all venues. CaptiFi API: GET /stats.

venue_id.description: Limit to one venue id (from captifi_list_venues). Default: every venue on the account.
